edge_cases: full single-head attention: QK^T (HMX) -> scale+softmax (HVX) -> A.V (HMX)
K stored [S,D] row-major (row j IS key vector j) -> QK^T needs only swapped crouton tile indices, no transpose buffer
A.V reduction axis is the key axis S; V is a generic B[K,N] operand (no transpose)
softmax over the KEY axis; nearmiss_wrongaxis softmaxes over the query axis (must fail)
attention scale applied as >>4 on the requant field; nearmiss_noscale omits it (must fail)
softmax probs are a normalized row (sum ~255) so the A.V accumulator stays < 2048 -> requant field exact
query row of all-zeros -> uniform softmax edge case
both HMX matmuls: 2x2 grid of 32x32 crouton tiles, 2-tile reduction, one mxclracc per output tile
crouton pack/unpack staged in cacheable DDR + bulk 128B HVX vector copies to/from VTCM (scalar VTCM access ~48 cyc)
scores/probs intermediates in cacheable DDR (4KB too small for DMA to beat a vector copy)
input ranges chosen so every requant field < 2048 (12-bit field exact, whole block bit-exact)
name: i8_attention_block

params.exp_lut: 256 uint8 entries (runtime), fixed-point exp, index 255 = exp(0)
params.scale: arithmetic >>4 on the 0x40-requant field (net ~1/15, in the 1/sqrt(D) regime)
